what: The machines behind the experiments: what each is, as read from the machine itself, and which committed runs it measured (matched on each run's fingerprint host block). Captured 2026-10-18 with hardware/linux.sh and hardware/mac.sh; the cloud runner could not be captured and is described from the run fingerprints alone.

machines.name: Mac mini (2018)
machines.role: the homelab host: it ran the first five experiments, local arms on its CPU and hosted arms as API calls through a LiteLLM gateway it also hosts
machines.summary: Intel Core i7-8700B, 6 cores / 12 threads, 32 GB

machines.name: Cloud runner
machines.role: 4-core Linux containers from Anthropic cloud coding sessions (at least two instances, by the kernel release each run records); they ran the six local models that need torch 2.6 or later (the distilled and XSum BARTs, the three bert-base fine-tunes) and SummEval's seven free scorers, and re-timed the BARTs on one machine (harness/data/runs-linux)
machines.summary: 4-core Linux (x86_64) containers; a session's container, so not captured

machines.name: GMKtec EVO-X3
machines.role: the workstation SummEval's 24 hosted judges were called from, and where local LLMs (MBPP+) are being measured

captured_output.cpu: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

machines.summary: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo) with Radeon 8060S, 32 threads, 128 GB unified memory

machines.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark
machines.role: owned, and serves local models in the homelab; no committed run here was measured on it
machines.summary: NVIDIA GB10, 20 Arm cores, 128 GB unified memory

machines.name: MacBook Pro (M4 Pro)
machines.role: the laptop the work is driven from; no committed run here was measured on it
machines.summary: Apple M4 Pro, 14 cores, 48 GB unified memory
